CustomField.description: What type of action to execute. FieldUpdate: sets a field on the target record. EmailAlert: sends an email using an email template. CustomApex: delegates to an Apex class implementing IApprovalAction (advanced, optional extensibility).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: FieldUpdate requires TargetFieldApiName__c and FieldValue__c. EmailAlert requires EmailTemplateName__c; recipients controlled via RecipientType__c, AdditionalQueues__c, and AdditionalUsers__c. CustomApex requires ActionClass__c.
CustomField.label: Action Kind
